tools.name: ask_openai
tools.description: Send a prompt to OpenAI and get a response. Default model: gpt-5.4 (Best overall model. Strong coding, reasoning, and tool use.). For harder reasoning tasks, override with model: "gpt-5.4-pro" (slower, may take minutes). Available models: gpt-5.4-pro, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano

prompt.description: The prompt to send to OpenAI

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to set the context/role for the model

model.description: Model to use. Defaults to gpt-5.4. Use "gpt-5.4-pro" for deep reasoning (slower). Options: gpt-5.4-pro, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano

reasoning_effort.description: Controls how much reasoning effort the model spends. "high" = more thorough but slower/costlier. Default: model decides. Particularly useful with gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-pro.

tools.name: ask_gemini
tools.description: Send a prompt to Google Gemini and get a response. Default model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview (Flagship model for complex reasoning, agentic workflows, and deep context.). Thinking is enabled at "high" level by default. Available models: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview

prompt.description: The prompt to send to Gemini

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to set the context/role for the model

model.description: Model to use. Defaults to gemini-3.1-pro-preview. Options: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview

tools.name: ask_all
tools.description: Send the same prompt to BOTH OpenAI (gpt-5.4) and Gemini (gemini-3.1-pro-preview) in parallel. Returns both responses for comparison and cross-validation. If one provider fails, the other's response is still returned. If both fail, returns an error. Ideal for the /council workflow.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to both providers

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt applied to both providers

openai_reasoning_effort.description: OpenAI reasoning effort override. "high" = more thorough analysis.
